title: AOK cleanroom reproduction report
description: Report from a cleanroom reproduction child (feature ③, plan §3③). The child runs the entry document's commands verbatim at a fixed sha in a minimal environment; any action the document does not state is itself a defect. Documents must not be edited (checked by diff). The report goes to a PR comment and the ledger, and the parent gets an `AOK/1 result`. Assurance covers a clean cloud environment only; steps needing internal networks, devices or secrets are recorded as env_limit.

repo.description: Repository under test, `owner/repo` or clone URL.

sha.description: Commit checked out (create_session source_revision); full 40-char sha recommended.

env.description: Environment facts, recorded because setup scripts, CLAUDE.md and hooks can fill prerequisites the docs do not state.

env_id.description: environment_id the child ran in (should be the minimal environment, D9).

cc_version.description: Claude Code version reported by the child.

session_start_tail.description: Tail of the SessionStart hook / setup output.

steps.description: Commands executed, in order, exactly as written in the documents.

first_failure.description: First failing step with its raw stderr preserved; null when nothing failed.

n.description: Step number of the first failure.

stderr_head.description: Head of the raw stderr of the failure.

type.description: doc_missing = a needed action is not documented; doc_wrong = documented command is wrong; env_limit = needs internal network/device/secret (recorded, not a defect of the docs); flaky = differs across two runs at the same sha; test_fail = tests fail.

step.description: Step number the finding refers to; null if not tied to a step.

evidence.description: Raw output excerpt or explanation backing the finding.

cost_usd.description: Child session cost in USD as read from get_session.

cmd.description: Command run, verbatim from the document.

exit.description: Exit code; null if the step could not be run.

deviation.description: Any action taken that the document does not state (itself a defect); null if none.
